This enables reflection-based attacks and direct Runtime execution.\n\n## Fix Implementation\n\n### New Security Component\n- **File**: `core/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/js/JavaScriptSecurityShutter.java`\n- **Purpose**: Implements `ClassShutter` interface to block all Java class access from JavaScript\n- **Implementation**: Returns `false` for all class visibility checks\n\n### Modified Files (6 files)\n\n1. **`core/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/java/util/common/parsers/JavaScriptParser.java`**\n   - Added ClassShutter to JavaScript parsing context\n\n2. **`processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/filter/JavaScriptDimFilter.java`**\n   - Added ClassShutter to JavaScript filter predicate factory\n   - Prevents Java class access in filter functions\n\n3. **`processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/extraction/JavaScriptExtractionFn.java`**\n   - Added ClassShutter to JavaScript extraction function context\n\n4. **`processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/aggregation/post/JavaScriptPostAggregator.java`**\n   - Added ClassShutter to post-aggregator function compilation\n\n5. **`processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/aggregation/JavaScriptAggregatorFactory.java`**\n   - Added ClassShutter to aggregator script compilation\n\n### How the Fix Works\n\nEach JavaScript context is now initialized with:\n```java\ncontext.setClassShutter(new JavaScriptSecurityShutter());\n```\n\nThis prevents JavaScript code from:\n- Accessing Java classes via `java.lang.Runtime`\n- Using reflection to invoke Java methods\n- Creating new Java objects\n- Any other Java interop through the Rhino engine\n\n## Security Impact\n\n- **Blocks all RCE attacks** via JavaScript code execution\n- **Maintains JavaScript functionality** for legitimate data transformations\n- **Non-breaking change**: Legitimate JavaScript functions continue to work\n- **Zero performance impact**: ClassShutter is checked at engine initialization only\n\n## Testing Recommendations\n\n1. **Negative Tests** (Should be blocked):\n   - JavaScript filters attempting `java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().exec()`\n   - Filters using empty string keys `\"\"`\n   - Post-aggregators trying to access Java classes\n   - Extraction functions attempting reflection\n\n2. **Positive Tests** (Should still work):\n   -
